mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 5.0% over 3 months indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) above 0.5% from prior month signal broad demand contraction, reducing corporate revenues and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% from prior month but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100.0 signals manufacturing sector weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic slowdown approaches.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regime, INDPRO falls below 100.0 but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction (HOUST) above 1150.0 (thousands of units) signals strong housing market activity, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST remains above 1150.0 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rising above 2.5% year-over-year signals accelerating inflation, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% YoY for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market stress, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth declines > 0.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 1 month but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 103.0 (relative to 2017=100) signals robust manufacturing activity, boosting corporate profits and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains above 103.0 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.
